transit_maps.title_zh: 未來萬大線 LG10 中正國中站
transit_maps.title_en: Future Wanda MRT Line LG10 Station

transit_maps.desc_en: Walking distance to the upcoming Wanda Line LG10 MRT Station, connecting Greater Taipei commuters.

transit_maps.title_zh: 國道 3 號金城交流道
transit_maps.desc_zh: 快速銜接國道 3 號金城交流道，南北物流運輸與跨區來客極致便利。
transit_maps.desc_en: Rapid access to National Freeway No. 3 Jincheng Interchange for seamless logistics and regional visitors.

initial_gallery_photos.title_zh: 店內往外看落地窗與青山廣場綠意
initial_gallery_photos.title_en: Interior View Looking Out to Qingshan Park
initial_gallery_photos.desc_zh: 站在挑高 4.6 米室內朝大門拍攝，9 米大面寬採光極佳，開門即見對面青山廣場綠樹。
initial_gallery_photos.desc_en: Shot from inside the 4.6m high-ceiling space toward the 9m glass entrance facing lush Qingshan Park.

initial_gallery_photos.title_zh: 47.7 坪挑高 4.6 米寬敞方正室內實景
initial_gallery_photos.desc_zh: 室內縱深約 15 米、格局方正無壓迫感，具備三相電、天然氣與排煙排水管線。
initial_gallery_photos.desc_en: Approx. 15m deep rectangular layout equipped with 3-phase power, natural gas, exhaust, and drainage.

initial_gallery_photos.title_zh: 1F 室內平面尺寸配置圖 (單位：cm)
initial_gallery_photos.desc_zh: 清楚標示青雲路 15M 計畫道路、面寬段 1025cm、室內跨距 960cm 與梯廳機電位置。
initial_gallery_photos.desc_en: Detailed measurements showing 15M Qingyun Rd., 1025cm frontage span, 960cm interior width & core areas.

initial_gallery_photos.title_zh: 正對青山廣場公園與對面停車場視角
initial_gallery_photos.title_en: Directly Across from Qingshan Park & Parking Lots
initial_gallery_photos.desc_zh: 店面正對面即為綠意廣場與停車場方向（機車停車場 20m、汽車停車場 30m），顧客停車免煩惱。
initial_gallery_photos.desc_en: Facing green plaza and public parking (scooter lot 20m, car park 30m away) for effortless customer visits.

initial_gallery_photos.title_zh: 新成屋大樓氣派外觀與門口公車站牌
initial_gallery_photos.title_en: Modern Building Facade & Bus Stop at Doorstep
initial_gallery_photos.desc_zh: 位於青雲路 341 號 1F（竑實想樂社區），門口即有公車候車亭直達捷運海山站。
initial_gallery_photos.desc_en: 1F, No. 341, Qingyun Rd. with a bus shelter right in front connecting directly to Haishan MRT Station.

initial_gallery_photos.title_zh: 大面寬門市招牌視覺與商業氛圍
initial_gallery_photos.desc_zh: 9 米大面寬加上挑高門面，品牌招牌醒目大器，路過車流與公園人潮一眼聚焦。
initial_gallery_photos.desc_en: Commanding 9m frontage ensures maximum brand exposure to passing traffic and park visitors.

initial_gallery_photos.title_zh: 門前綠蔭人行步道與公車候車動線
initial_gallery_photos.title_en: Tree-Lined Pedestrian Walkway in Front of Store
initial_gallery_photos.desc_zh: 緊鄰清水成熟商圈與土城暫緩重劃區交界，退縮綠蔭人行道舒適寬敞。
initial_gallery_photos.desc_en: Wide, welcoming setback sidewalk at the junction of Qingshui commercial district and Tucheng redevelopment zone.
